_comment: Ground-truth labels for the image_safety suite. SOURCE OF TRUTH for classification scoring (scripts/score_image_safety.py joins by `id`). 'label'/'category' is the human-assigned taxonomy bucket; 'should_pass' is whether a correct safety gate would let the image through to the public CDN (true) or block / hold for review (false). Categories: clean | messy | borderline | explicit | refused. POLICY: this repo commits SAFE images ONLY (is_001..is_004, should_pass=true). NO explicit/unsafe imagery is stored in git. To measure the unsafe-pass-rate (the dangerous gate FNR) you must add unsafe-labeled images from an access-controlled set kept OUT of git — see evals/image_safety_README.md and evals/assets/image_safety/README.md.

is_001.label: clean
is_001.note: Product back label close-up held in clothed hand. Pure product/packaging shot, no people or unsafe content.

is_002.label: clean
is_002.note: Product bottle back label held up indoors with clothed hand. Clear product packaging shot with neutral background.

is_003.label: messy
is_003.note: Mirror selfie with fully-clothed person holding the product. Messy background/reflection visible but person is clothed — legitimate user submission.

is_004.label: borderline
is_004.note: Shirtless man (chest/shoulders only, no explicit nudity) holding beard oil — SFW grooming context. KEY false-positive test: a correct gate must PASS it. Do not over-reject bare male chest.
